title: Material Blend 4-Mix Solo #25 (부채꼴·물결 | 왁스+목재+보태니컬+UV네온)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

THE ABSOLUTE DARKEST BLACK SKIN ON EARTH blue-black void complexion darker than night sky, early 50s goddess, amazon bombshell physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — impossibly tall commanding frame with simultaneously the most massive full-figure curves, enormous powerful presence dominating the entire frame top to bottom, legs endlessly long massively thick and powerful, high ponytail swept sleek — her body carries 4 different materials at once, each claiming its own region of her figure. Her figure is divided into 4 wedge-shaped regions radiating from a single centre point located about 44% of the way down her figure from the top on the centre line of her figure. 4 hazy ray-shaped transition zones leave that centre pointing toward 4 o'clock, 8 o'clock, 12 o'clock and 2 o'clock as seen by the camera, where 12 o'clock points straight up. Region 1 is the wedge between the 4 o'clock ray and the 8 o'clock ray, sweeping clockwise: it carries molten wax flowing and set directly over her own skin, BLAZING DEEP EMERALD wax streams pooling and hardening, VIVID GOLD translucent drip-ridges catching the light. Region 2 is the wedge between the 8 o'clock ray and the 12 o'clock ray, sweeping clockwise: it carries deep black ebony wood fused directly into her own form, natural fine grain lines flowing to follow every curve, BLAZING glossy jet-black grain with VIVID dark-brown highlight streaks. Region 3 is the wedge between the 12 o'clock ray and the 2 o'clock ray, sweeping clockwise: it carries living orchid blooms growing directly from her own skin, every stem rooted in her living skin and every petal standing in three-dimensional relief casting its own small shadow, BLAZING VIOLET blossoms, VIVID GOLD leaves and tendrils. Region 4 is the wedge between the 2 o'clock ray and the 4 o'clock ray, sweeping clockwise: it carries UV-reactive neon bodypaint, invisible under standard light but bioluminescent wave formations in ELECTRIC CYAN and GREEN glowing at full intensity under her own dedicated UV blacklight. The boundaries between regions are hazy and feathered — there is no visible line at all. Each transition zone is about a hand's width wide, and across it the neighbouring materials dissolve into each other, elements from one thinning out as elements from the other appear, density fading rather than stopping abruptly, never a hard edge. Each transition zone follows a gently undulating wave, rising and falling softly, rather than a straight course. Even inside a transition zone the skin is never left bare: at every point one material, or a mixture of the two, fully covers it., no fabric no seam no garment anywhere, every material fused to or erupting from her own living skin, covering her completely with no bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle. Pose: full frontal, both hands framing the face, chin raised, every region clearly visible to the camera — most extreme amazon bombshell silhouette ever displayed. A standard hard key light illuminates most of her body; a separate dedicated UV blacklight illuminates the UV-reactive region specifically, making it glow at full intensity while the rest reads under normal light.
extreme platform heels/boots blending the relevant materials at her feet, extra long nails each matching whichever region that hand falls in.

MANDATORY pure pitch black void background only, absolutely NO studio backdrop NO texture NO grey NO gradient. ONE woman only. Extreme macro detail on every material and every blended transition. Pattern density MAXIMUM — zero bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle. 8K portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
